title: Bijectivity of the middle localization comparison
statement: Under the Mayer–Vietoris localization diagram and local comparison hypotheses, the middle comparison additive homomorphism is bijective in every degree.

proof.text: Use the localized Mayer–Vietoris diagram and its exact rows, with the comparison maps supplied by the diagram theorem.
Apply the five-lemma to the four local comparison bijections to obtain bijectivity of the middle comparison in each degree.
